title: Hy Saawan Okhiyan Ne, Zainab De Veer Diyan
body:
Raitan Te Katdiyan Paiyan, Rugaan Shabbir Diyan
<<DIVIDER>>
1)Mai Qatl Sajdech Veeran, Da Vekhdi Raiyan
Na Maaro Sattar Kadam Ton, Pukaardi Raiyan
Khanjar Di Zarban Ne Raiyan, Kaleja Cheer Diyan
<<DIVIDER>>
2)Hussain Akhay Bhira Nu, Hai Apne Gal Laa Ke
Abbas Taras Gayawan, Tu Menu Veer Akhay
Na Fir Hichkiyan Rukkiyan, Ghazi De Peer Diyan
<<DIVIDER>>
3)Mai Tere Sajde Nu Sadqe, Rasool Ay Akhay
Mai Tere Sabar Nu Sadqe, Batool Ay Akhay
Shabbir Laajaan ne Rakhiyan, Ali Ameer Diyan
<<DIVIDER>>
4)Anokha Jug Ton Hai Larda, Ay Jung Tu Takkeya
Hai Khaa Ke Teer Vi Pyu Da, Buland Sar Rakheya
Galay Na Toriyan Jisne, Hai Nokaan Teer Diyan
<<DIVIDER>>
5)Hussain Bhain De Khayme, Te Akay Ronda Reya
Rakheen Khayal Tu Abid, Da Bhain Mai Challeya
Hai Rawaan Okhiyan Mere, Puttar Aseer Diyan
<<DIVIDER>>
6)Ghum e Hussain Nu Jag Te, Sada Manaawan Gay
Nishan Seenay Te Matam, Da Leke Jaawaan Gay
Kamar Te Sir Te Ne Zarbaan, Mola Zanjeer Diyan
<<DIVIDER>>
7)Hur Apne Putraan Nu Lekay, Shabbir Kol Aaya
Reya Ay Maafiyan Mungda, Roya Te Kurlaaya
Mola Tu Badliyaan Sochaan, Mere Zameer Diyan
<<DIVIDER>>
8)Sakina Mashq Nu Cha Ke, Hai Ghazi Kol Aayi
Lay Aaj Paani Tu Mumtaa-z Mashq Gal Paayi
Hai Khushk Bulliya Ne Chacha, Mere Sagheer Diyan
